name: Quest Context
vision_statement: The AI knows each person's own Quest, nobody else's.
opportunities: A person's Quest holds more than any one request can read, and each piece belongs to one person, so how it is fed, stored and kept apart is a question the parent solution leaves open.
solution_coherence: Quest Context knows each person's own Quest and nobody else's. Card Store keeps the person's context cards where they must live. Persist Cards writes them to a folder, a vector database or Quest itself. Cache Cards serves the last listing and holds failed writes while a backend is down. Feed Context Sources tells the assistant what is new in a quest since it last looked.
